name: Kallada

source.name: Confluence of the Kulathupuzha, Chendurni and Kalthuruthy streams, near Ponmudi

did_you_know: The Kallada is Kollam district's longest river and is formed by the confluence of three streams draining the Shendurney Wildlife Sanctuary.
The Kallada Irrigation Project on the river is the largest irrigation scheme in Kerala.
Its estuary, the Ashtamudi Lake, is a Ramsar-listed wetland known for its distinctive eight-branched, palm-shaped shoreline.
